pokedexEntries.ru: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.

pokedexEntries.sa: BARBOACH’s body is covered with a slimy film. If a foe grabs it, this POKéMON just slips out of the enemy’s grip. This POKéMON grows weak if the slimy coating dries up.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.

pokedexEntries.em: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the BARBOACH’s body.

pokedexEntries.di: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.

pokedexEntries.prl: Its whiskers make a superb radar. They are used to locate prey, even in the murkiest of water.

pokedexEntries.pt: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

pokedexEntries.hgss: BARBOACH uses its whiskers to taste things just as a person uses his or her tongue to taste things.

pokedexEntries.bw: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

pokedexEntries.su: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.

pokedexEntries.mo: Its slippery body is hard to grasp, so much so that there are festivals where people compete to see how many they can catch barehanded.

pokedexEntries.us: Its entire body is gooey. When pecked at by bird Pokémon, it slips and slides its way to freedom.

pokedexEntries.um: Its whiskers are filled with nerves. They can sense smells and flavors just as a person’s nose or tongue would.

pokedexEntries.la: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.
